title: QaRecord
description: Logical curated Q&A record the QA fast-path serves. Physically split across edu_ai.qa_entries (answer) and edu_ai.qa_variants (indexed phrasings). DDL is the physical source of truth (postgres/init/*.sql); this schema documents the logical shape the retrieval code reads.

pack_id.description: Owning QA pack (qa_pack_manifest.pack_id). Scoped by grade in the router.

answer_md.description: Curated answer, Markdown. Returned verbatim on a QA hit (no LLM).

asset_refs.description: Sources the CURATOR cited for this answer (qa_entries.asset_refs), filled from the pack CSV's `sources` column. Returned as SearchResponse.sources on a QA hit. A claim about the real world, not retrieval provenance: nothing verifies the links, and the answer is delivered whether or not they resolve.

title.description: Link text; the URL itself when the curator gave no title.

url.description: http(s) only — other schemes are dropped at ingest. Null for a source with no link (a paper document).

is_active.description: Soft-versioning flag; only active entries are matched.

variants.description: Indexed phrasings of the question (qa_variants). Each carries the three reduced forms the lexical steps match on.

items.description: Reduced forms MUST follow the parity contract (contracts/parity/); the index tsvectors (ts_norm/ts_lemma/ts_stem) are built from these.

embedding.description: Optional question embedding (qa_embedding) for the qa_vector fallback; dimension per the active embedding_registry model.
